data.name: Mehira
data.gender_notes: Mehira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mahir', meaning radiant or shining, Mehira is a name that symbolizes the gentle and calming light of the moon. In Islamic tradition, the moon is often associated with tranquility, wisdom, and renewal. The name Mehira carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehira usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehira total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
